metadata.title: Monochrome Portrait with High-Contrast Serif Overlay

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, black-and-white studio portrait of a man in a white ribbed tank top, featuring a massive, centered serif typeface that overlaps the subject's torso, accented by small, technical-style yellow numeric text.
coreVisualRelationships: The large black text acts as a horizontal band dividing the subject's head from the lower torso.
The high-contrast lighting on the subject's skin mirrors the sharp contrast of the black typography.
The small yellow text provides a modern, technical counterpoint to the classic serif display font.
coreInvariants: Yellow accent color for secondary metadata

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered, cropped from the waist up, filling approximately 80% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, bold serif letters spanning the horizontal center of the image.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's profile face, moves down to the large black text, and settles on the bright yellow numeric details in the lower right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Uniform light grey background providing a clean stage for the subject and text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Light grey background and mid-tone grey skin tones.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black for the primary display typography and shadows.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant golden yellow for technical metadata and catalog numbers.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the black text and the white tank top.

letterConstructionRules: Extreme contrast between thick and thin strokes
characterSpecificRedesigns: None; relies on the inherent geometry of the typeface.

composition.position: bottom right of the display text

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme scale and style contrast: massive elegant serif paired with tiny industrial sans-serif.
graphicDevices: Small square bullet points between metadata items

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the extreme stroke contrast and elegant verticality.
Matches the technical, industrial feel of the yellow metadata.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A high-contrast black and white studio portrait of a man with a shaved head, looking to the side in profile. He is wearing a white ribbed tank top. The background is a flat, neutral light grey. The lighting should emphasize the musculature and skin texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, bold, black Didone-style serif name across the center of the image. In the bottom right corner of this text, add small, bright yellow technical numbers and text in a condensed geometric sans-serif, separated by small square icons.

verificationChecks: Is the primary text large enough to span the width of the subject?
Is the yellow text clearly legible but significantly smaller than the main title?
Is the image strictly monochrome except for the yellow text?
Does the main text overlap the subject's white tank top?

adjustableVariables: Vertical position of the text band
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is solid black without transparency.
Verify the yellow is a saturated 'safety' or 'golden' yellow.
Check that the subject's skin tones have a rich, metallic sheen.
Confirm the background remains a flat, non-distracting grey.
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio monochrome portrait + Oversized Didone overlay + Industrial yellow metadata = 90s R&B aesthetic.
